objects.value: Praying Mantis (various species like Giant African, Orchid, Ghost)
Stick Insects (various species like Indian Stick, Giant Walking Stick)
Beetle (various species like Hercules Beetle, Flower Beetle)
Millipede (various species like Giant African, Scarlet Millipede)
Centipede (various species - handle with caution, some can bite)
Tarantula (various species - technically arachnids, but often grouped with insects in the pet trade)
Scorpion (various species - handle with extreme caution, venomous)
Crickets (often kept as feeders but some find them interesting pets)
Mealworms (similarly, mostly feeders but sometimes kept as pets)
